description: This Java class provides utility methods to prevent infinite loops by limiting the number of iterations in do-while and while loops. It defines an interface LoopBody and methods runSafeDoWhileLoop and runSafeWhileLoop which execute loop bodies with a maximum iteration cap.

classes.name: LoopGuard
classes.description: A utility class for guarding against infinite loops by enforcing a maximum number of iterations during loop execution.

methods.name: runSafeDoWhileLoop
methods.description: Executes a do-while loop safely with a maximum iteration limit to prevent infinite looping.

methods.name: runSafeWhileLoop
methods.description: Executes a while loop safely with a maximum iteration limit to prevent infinite looping.
